name: CBFD-Recompiled
description: Conker's Bad Fur Day recompiled: native PS Vita port (and the PC recomp it builds on). No game data.
long_description: A native PC port of **Conker's Bad Fur Day** (N64, US version). It's built by statically recompiling the game with N64Recomp, starting from the Conker decompilation. It runs on N64ModernRuntime and is rendered by RT64.
